output.one_liner: Vonage provides cloud-based communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, messaging, and identity verification across multiple channels.

auth.notes: Three primary authentication methods: API Key and Secret, Basic Authentication (Base64 encoded in header), and JWT. JWT recommended for production use, webhooks, and advanced features like ACLs.

evidence.snippet: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using: API Key and Secret (Header), JSON Web Token (JWT)
The Messages API supports either Basic authentication or JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication
We recommend that you use JWT authentication in production for most use-cases.

access.notes: Free account signup includes initial free credit and sandbox/demo accounts for testing. Continued production use requires topping up with payment. Per-request billing model.

evidence.snippet: sign up for an account. This will give you an API key and secret that you can use to access our APIs.
We'll give you some free credit when you first open your account and you can top up.
this feature is only available for demo or trial accounts until you add credit to your account.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Messages API default rate limit is 75 requests per second per API key; case-by-case increases available.

evidence.snippet: SMS API, Voice API, Messages API, Video API, Conversation API, Account API, External Accounts API, Pricing API
OpenAPI is an industry standard specification for describing APIs. We use OpenAPI to describe all our APIs
SMS API, Voice API, Verify API, Messages and Dispatch APIs support webhooks
The default rate limit for requests to the Messages API is 75 requests per second per API key.
The Vonage MCP Server enables AI agents and developer tools to discover, describe, and use Vonage capabilities via the Model Context Protocol.
A very simple MCP Server with telephony tools like voice call and sms. Vonage API is used for calls, SMS, Speech-to-Text and Speech Recognition.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve signup with free trial, broad REST API surface with published OpenAPI specs, webhooks support, official MCP server, multiple SDKs, and clear documentation enable building a production toolkit today.

overview_evidence.snippet: When you are ready to start building your app, you'll want to use one of our Server SDKs instead of coding each request by hand.
The Messages API allows you to send and in some cases receive messages over SMS, MMS, RCS, Facebook Messenger, Viber, WhatsApp and Email.
